input: Find a local drum circle to join monthly

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Drum circles are hyper-local; knowing the city or neighbourhood is essential to finding relevant options.
Drum circles vary widely — West African djembe, Brazilian, Native American, freeform community jams — and the style shapes which groups to look for.
Some circles are beginner-welcoming with loaner drums; others expect participants to bring skill and their own instrument.
Whether the user owns a drum affects which circles are accessible and what to prioritise when searching.
Drum circles happen on specific days and times (e.g., full-moon evenings, weekend mornings); knowing the user's free windows narrows viable options.
Some circles are spiritual/ceremonial, others are purely social or therapeutic — the preferred atmosphere determines which communities to target.

keyUnknowns.axis: success criteria / what joining looks like
keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Success could mean simply attending once, becoming a regular member, or even performing — clarifying this shapes how much follow-through the plan needs.

gold.taskTitle: Find and join a local monthly drum circle
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to locate a recurring drum circle in their area and commit to attending it on a monthly basis.

questions.title: What city or neighbourhood are you based in?
questions.description: Identifies the geographic area to search for local drum circles.

questions.title: What drumming style or tradition interests you most?
questions.description: Determines whether to look for West African, Brazilian, freeform community, Native American, or other style-specific circles.

questions.title: How would you describe your current drumming experience level?
questions.description: Establishes whether to prioritise beginner-friendly circles or groups suited to more experienced players.

questions.title: Do you already own a drum you can bring?
questions.description: Determines whether circles that provide loaner instruments need to be prioritised in the search.

questions.title: Which days or times of the week are you generally free?
questions.description: Filters circles by their recurring schedule to find ones the user can realistically attend monthly.

questions.title: Do you prefer a social, spiritual, or therapeutic circle atmosphere?
questions.description: Matches the user to communities that reflect their preferred group vibe and purpose.

questions.title: What does successfully joining look like to you?
questions.description: Clarifies whether the goal is to attend a first session, become a recurring member, or something deeper like leading or performing.
questions.coversAxis: success criteria / what joining looks like
